mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.title, p.goal, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.daily_minutes, p.focus_topics_json, p.generation_status, p.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_study_plan_task t WHERE t.plan_id = p.id AND t.user_id = p.user_id) AS task_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_study_plan_task t WHERE t.plan_id = p.id AND t.user_id = p.user_id AND t.completed = 1) AS completed_task_count FROM sa_study_plan p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.generation_status = 'READY' ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
